import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.stats_utils import *

# The main block will run automatically, producing SUMMARY_v1_1.md and COMPARISON_v1_1.md
# Additional cross-dataset comparison
ROOT = pathlib.Path("storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments")
comp_paths = [
    ROOT/"micro_probe_t115/results.jsonl",
    ROOT/"concurrency/results.jsonl",
    ROOT/"cooldown_ladder/axiom/results.jsonl",
    ROOT/"crossover/axiom/phase_a_results.jsonl",
    ROOT/"crossover/axiom/phase_b_results.jsonl",
    ROOT/"crossover/logos/phase_b_results.jsonl"
]
comp = compare_datasets(comp_paths)
print(json.dumps(comp, indent=2))

# If path multiplier data exists, analyze it
path_mult_path = ROOT/"path_multiplier/results.jsonl"
if path_mult_path.exists():
    summ = summarize_file(path_mult_path, group_by="depth")
    print(json.dumps({"path_multiplier_summary": summ}, indent=2))
    # Generate multiplier table
    if summ["groups"]:
        baseline = next(g["mean"] for g in summ["groups"] if g.get("depth") == 1)
        for g in summ["groups"]:
            g["multiplier"] = g["mean"] / baseline if baseline else np.nan
        mult_table = md_table(summ["groups"], ["depth", "mean", "std", "multiplier"])
        mult_out = ROOT/"path_multiplier/MULTIPLIER_TABLE.md"
        mult_out.write_text(mult_table, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"Multiplier table saved to {mult_out}")

# For extended cooldown if available
extended_path = ROOT/"cooldown_ladder/axiom/results_v1_1.jsonl"
if extended_path.exists():
    ext_summ = summarize_file(extended_path, group_by="cooldown_label")
    print(json.dumps({"extended_cooldown": ext_summ}, indent=2))
